title: Ruthless Rise Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Rise by Ruthless pairs two of the most vibrant tropical flavours in a beautifully balanced e-liquid. The delicate floral sweetness of Lychee meets the rich, sun-ripened taste of Mango, creating a smooth, juicy vape that is both refreshing and deeply satisfying. This exotic combination delivers a bold fruit flavour with a naturally sweet finish, making it a great choice for vapers who enjoy bright, tropical blends. One of many incredible flavours found in the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill collection, Rise features a 70VG/30PG ratio for thick vapour production and a smooth inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. For over a decade, Ruthless has been setting the standard for bold, trend-defining e-liquids, blending premium ingredients with expertly crafted flavour profiles. Their dedication to quality ensures a consistently rich and satisfying vape experience.
